evidenceScope: Explicit summary whitelist; original artifact retains full raw diagnostic evidence. No worker programs, question payloads, answer bodies, console bodies or network bodies are copied here.

method.nativeWorkload: native-rational, variant 1, actual native-prepared model answer
method.order: First native Validate; 5 warm Validate; first native grade and 5 warm grades; graphical PythonChecker native Validate; first Python grade and 5 warm grades
method.uiClock: Browser performance.now: original click at window capture to verdict DOM mutation, including graphical collection/replay; excludes later MathJax paint
method.workerClock: Browser performance.now: real postMessage to response. Initialization is recorded separately and is included in first native Validate UI time.
method.cache: Fresh Chromium process, context/profile and worker per sample; OS and CDN caches are not cleared. Provenance fetches outside timed intervals can warm CDN caches.
method.scope: One public build, two accepted-answer workloads and one runner; descriptive samples, not a general device/network benchmark or confidence interval.

limitations: First Python grade reuses an initialized native worker and measures incremental Python startup, not a second cold page.
Diagnostic stage clocks have different origins from the page clock.
UI completion is verdict DOM update, not final mathematics rendering.
Only these accepted answers and this exact deployment are measured; no previous-build speedup is inferred.

substitutions: initialize(card) captures its nearest wrapper's backend
grade status uses the selected backend label
